prompts.01-home:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: high fidelity desktop application design preview, page 1 of a coherent nine-screen PhD research attendance widget.
Primary request: redesign the main desktop widget as precise, refined translucent glass. Render ONE front-on 420x560 proportion rounded widget, centered, large enough to read, on a quiet pale sage-blue desktop wallpaper with gently blurred landscape forms, no desktop icons or other windows. This is a practical Windows desktop panel, not a phone, no phone bezel.
Material: neutral pearl translucent glass, visibly see the softly colored wallpaper through it, subtle upper-left light edge and soft shadow, 24px corners. Text opaque dark graphite. Restrained blue weekly ring and teal monthly ring. Segoe UI / clear Chinese sans typography. Delicate lucide-style line icons. No big opaque cards, thick borders, neon, heavy gradients or marketing labels.
Composition: 24px inset. Top compact city/weather line at left "上海  晴 21°C" with tiny sun icon, ellipsis settings at right. Below a large slender time "16:29" at left, with a compact two-line date "10月30日" "周五" at right. Fine divider. Middle paired progress rings: labels "本周 ›" and "本月 ›"; slender strokes, percentages "60%" and "56%"; totals "36 / 60 小时" and "120 / 216 小时" beneath. Rings sit directly on glass, no raised square backgrounds. A quiet rounded translucent strip below: "今日" and "6小时 / 12小时", pencil icon at right. Bottom a paired light glass row with briefcase "出差" and coffee "休假"; wide softly blue-tinted rounded "进入心流" button with focus icon below. Elegant clear hierarchy, balanced breathing room. Preserve every listed function and exact Chinese text. No extra UI sections or explanatory annotations. Single image, portrait aspect ratio, presentation-quality detailed pixels.
